layout_cost_assumptions.display: Each inner array is one visible physical group. Adjacent arrays on the same line have exactly one ordinary visible blank. Each array element is one of the22working drawings. JSON punctuation and group brackets are display notation, not additional ink signs.
layout_cost_assumptions.width: For this teaching sheet only, each working drawing and ordinary blank occupies one display cell; usable width is16cells. No native raster or geometry is asserted. Ordinary line breaks have only the meaning supplied by the fixed contracts.
layout_cost_assumptions.continuation_cost: The fixed continuation protocol and its corrected two-marker middle-line width condition apply without amendment. All displayed marker groups and blanks are physically paid. No hidden source length, sentence break or continuation metadata is supplied.
